gold_review.explanation: code_qa_reward never uses answer/info or runs the code: any syntactically valid Python with no unused imports/functions or magic numbers scores 1.0 (e.g. `pass`), so bug-fixing correctness is unmeasured. Under vf 0.3.x it is worse: non-dict messages fall back to text=str(completion), whose repr parses as a valid Python expression, so even the garbage reply scores 1.0.
